unit_vocabulary.meaning: `adj.` 十几岁的(指13至19岁), 青少年的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Many teenage boys and girls enjoy listening to pop music after school.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 合成词：teen（十三至十九）+ age（年龄）→ 十几岁的，青少年的。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: We watched an exciting thriller movie that kept us on the edge of our seats.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 词根记忆：thrill（使毛骨悚然，使震颤）+ -er（物）→ 惊悚惊险作品。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Developing eco-tourism has helped local villagers increase their income.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 词根记忆：tour（观光旅行）+ -ism（产业/主义）→ 旅游业。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Always give a truthful answer when someone asks for your honest opinion.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 词缀记忆：truth（真理，事实）+ -ful（充满……的）→ 诚实的，真实的。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `adj.` 典型的, 特有的, 独特的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: A bowl of warm noodles is a typical traditional breakfast in northern China.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 核心短语：be typical of（是……的典型特征）。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Scientists use modern space telescopes to explore the mysteries of the universe.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 词根记忆：uni-（单一）+ vers（旋转）→ 统一旋转的整体 → 宇宙，天地万物。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `adj.` 未知的, 不详的, 无名的, 不出名的 `n.` 未知数, 无名者, 未知的因素
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The brave astronaut flew into the unknown depths of space.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 前缀记忆：un-（不，未）+ known（已知的）→ 未知的，不出名的。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `adj.` 不寻常的, 特别的, 与众不同的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: It is quite unusual to see such heavy snow falling in April.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 前缀记忆：un-（不）+ usual（通常的）→ 不寻常的，特别的。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The school library provides books on various subjects from history to art.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 词根记忆：vary（变化）+ -ous（多……的）→ 各种各样的。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Farmers were picking ripe purple grapes in the sunny vineyard.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 合成词：vine（葡萄藤）+ yard（院子，场地）→ 葡萄园（注意vine读音由/vaɪn/缩弱为/vɪn/）。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The whole family dressed up to attend their cousin's wedding ceremony.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 常用搭配：wedding ceremony（结婚典礼），wedding cake（婚礼蛋糕）。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `adv.` 究竟在何处；究竟到哪里
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Wherever I go, Finally I go, To my home, sweet home.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: where(哪里) + ever(无论) = 无论哪里。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 野生救援(国际环保组织)
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: WildAid works globally to end the illegal wildlife trade and protect endangered animals.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 环保组织：wild（野生动物）+ aid（援助）→ 野生救援组织。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Even in her seventies, she always keeps a bright and youthful smile.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 词缀记忆：youth（青春）+ -ful（充满……的）→ 朝气蓬勃的，年轻的。
